references.text: Both illustrate how a woman finds comfort and a change of fate by finding favor with a protector.
Thematic connection between human grace as comfort (Ruth) and prayer for God's grace as comfort (Psalm).
Strong parallel in viewing the superior as God's representative for justice and comfort.
Parallel in humble behavior and self-description ('servant woman') to win favor.
Thematic parallel in how humble communication from a woman can calm a conflict and win favor.
Parallel in the motif of finding grace/mercy with a powerful man as God's instrument.
